what: A Reddit user (toomuchisjustenough), quoted in a secondary blog source, compares Etsy to "renting a space in a busy mall" versus Shopify as "a lone building on the side of the highway," noting that "Shopify isn't a marketplace; it's a platform for you to find and drive your own traffic."
